June, the ticket was **#8841**. I posted the answer in your #strategic-pod thread.

Gideon's 1 Jul message in the channel says he closed it with support that morning. The problem was on Vantorre's kiosk tablets. The standard Detention Summary template worked for their billing department once their IT cleared a browser cache issue on the tablets. So the cache clear on their side is what fixed it.

That is everything the channel says. I couldn't find the ticket record itself in the files I can see, so I have nothing more on it.
